4S8ZzNn3n5OnS1vzzA2WdA.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於9/10-16期間,WPV1新增2國共3例,分別為阿富汗2例、巴基斯坦1例;cVDPV2新增3國共4例,分別為剛果⺠主共和國2例、馬利/奈及利亞各1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦1件,cVDPV2新增索馬利亞2件。
4S8ZzNn3n5OnS1vzzA2WdA.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 10–16 September, WPV1 added 3 cases in two countries: 2 in Afghanistan and 1 in Pakistan. cVDPV2 added 4 cases in three countries: 2 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and 1 each in Mali and Nigeria. In environmental samples, WPV1 added one detection in Pakistan, and cVDPV2 added two detections in Somalia.

0D0a0Xks_etsZoVfRFRQLw.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於8/27-9/2期間,cVDPV1新增南蘇丹1例;cVDPV2新增3國共12例,分別為剛果⺠主共和國8例、南蘇丹3例、馬利1例;cVDPV3新增奈及利亞2 例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦6件 。
0D0a0Xks_etsZoVfRFRQLw.en: The GPEI reported that during 27 August–2 September, cVDPV1 added 1 case in South Sudan; cVDPV2 added 12 cases in three countries: 8 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 3 in South Sudan and 1 in Mali; cVDPV3 added 2 cases in Nigeria. In environmental samples, WPV1 added 6 detections in Pakistan.

KDRlz3r4l1zdeaPiasgEbw.zh: 非洲區自2025年初迄今年3/1,阿爾及利亞、查德、幾內亞、馬利、茅利塔亞、日、奈及利亞和南非8國共通報超過29,000 例疑病例,其中1,420例死亡(CFR:4.9%),其中 752例經實驗確定病例,主要集中於日(313例)、奈及利亞(211例)及南非(93例)。WHO評估疫情有進一步地理擴散的潛力、致死率偏高、控制疫情的資源(疫苗與DAT)嚴重不足、且監測與實驗室系統受限, 該區傳播風險為中,全球風險為低。 奈及利亞日(Niger)州疫情呈多點擴散,今年截至8月,累計報告124例確定病例,17例死亡(CFR:13.7%),高於該國同期平均(2.3%),病例主要為未接種疫苗之兒童。因疫苗覆蓋率低,以及跨區人口流動及疫苗猶豫等因素,該國刻正推動逐戶接種疫苗及與宗教領袖合作等措施,以防止疫情擴散。 塞內加爾今年5至8月進行病歷回溯調查(醫療機構病歷),有591 例曾出現喉嚨痛、扁桃腺炎等症狀,其中7例為確定病例,主要集中於東部凱杜古(Kedougou)及薩拉亞(Saraya)地區,該國已於受影響區加強疫苗補接種與主動監測,以防止疫情向周邊擴散。
KDRlz3r4l1zdeaPiasgEbw.en: From early 2025 to 1 March this year, eight countries in the African Region (Algeria, Chad, Guinea, Mali, Mauritania, Niger, Nigeria and South Africa) reported more than 29,000 suspected cases, of which 1,420 died (CFR 4.9%). 752 cases were laboratory-confirmed, mainly in Niger (313), Nigeria (211) and South Africa (93). WHO assesses that the outbreak has potential for further geographic spread and a high case fatality rate, that control resources (vaccines and diphtheria antitoxin, DAT) are severely insufficient, and that surveillance and laboratory systems are limited; the transmission risk in the region is moderate, and the global risk is low. In Niger State, Nigeria, the outbreak has spread across multiple points: as of August this year, 124 confirmed cases and 17 deaths had been cumulatively reported (CFR 13.7%), higher than the country's average for the same period (2.3%); most cases were unvaccinated children. Owing to low vaccine coverage, cross-regional population movement and vaccine hesitancy, the country is pursuing door-to-door vaccination and cooperation with religious leaders to prevent further spread. In Senegal, a retrospective review of medical records from May to August this year identified 591 cases with symptoms such as sore throat and tonsillitis, of which 7 were confirmed, mainly in the eastern Kédougou and Saraya areas. Senegal has strengthened catch-up vaccination and active surveillance in affected areas to prevent spread to surrounding areas.

44VM-a8M61mNqd6ddNEdjA.zh: 小兒麻痺症全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於6/18-24期間,cVDPV1 新增2國共3例,分別為寮國2例(前已掌握)、衣索比亞1例;cVDPV2新增中非共和國/馬利各1例;環境樣本部分,cVDPV2新增奈及利亞1件。
44VM-a8M61mNqd6ddNEdjA.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported for the period 18–24 June: cVDPV1 cases increased by 3 across 2 countries, with 2 in Laos (previously identified) and 1 in Ethiopia; cVDPV2 cases increased by 1 each in the Central African Republic and Mali; and for environmental samples, cVDPV2 increased by 1 in Nigeria.

ntGQB584jFhG2l4dPlDOjQ.zh: WHO非洲區自去(2025)年截至今年3/1共計8國(阿爾及利亞、查德、幾內亞、馬利、茅利塔亞、日、奈及利亞、南非)累計報告逾2.9萬例疑病例,其中1.8萬例為確定病例,1,420例死亡,752例經實驗室確診,相較WHO於去年10月進行之風險評估,疑病例新增約1.1萬例,死亡人數新增529例,奈及利亞為該區疑及死亡病例最多國家,佔5成以上,病患以5-14歲兒童年齡層及女性為主。WHO考量該區每週新增病例數整體呈下降趨勢且多數國家已啟動應變工作,惟仍有診斷試劑/檢驗/藥物缺乏等問題,評估非洲區整體公共衛生風險由「高」調整為「中」,另非洲區以外多數國家具備完善之免疫計畫與健全之監測系統,全球公共衛生風險為「低」,惟仍須留意至非洲區旅遊之罹病風險。
ntGQB584jFhG2l4dPlDOjQ.en: The WHO African Region reported more than 29,000 suspected cases from last year through 1 March this year across eight countries (Algeria, Chad, Equatorial Guinea, Mauritania, Niger, Nigeria, Mali and South Africa). Of these, 18,000 were classified as confirmed cases, 1,420 died, and 752 were laboratory-confirmed. Compared with the WHO risk assessment conducted in October last year, suspected cases increased by about 11,000 and deaths by 529. Nigeria accounted for more than half of the suspected and fatal cases in the region, and patients were mainly children aged 5–14 years and females. WHO noted that weekly new cases in the region are generally declining and most countries have activated response operations, but shortages of diagnostic tests, laboratory capacity and drugs persist. WHO has therefore revised the overall public health risk for the African Region from 'high' to 'moderate'. Most countries outside Africa have robust immunization programmes and sound surveillance systems, so the global public health risk is assessed as 'low'; however, the risk of disease for travellers to the African Region should still be noted.

NST5qw4KSTLm8LGw8R6uiA.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於1/22-1/28期間,WPV1新增阿富汗1例;cVDPV2新增中非共和國/查德/馬利各1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦9件、阿富汗5件,cVDPV2新增5國共6件,分別為馬拉威2件、阿爾及利亞/查德/納米比亞/英國各1件。
NST5qw4KSTLm8LGw8R6uiA.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 22 and 28 January, WPV1 had one new case in Afghanistan, and cVDPV2 had one new case each in the Central African Republic, Chad and Mali. For environmental samples, WPV1 had 9 new positive samples in Pakistan and 5 in Afghanistan. cVDPV2 had 6 new samples across 5 countries: 2 in Malawi, and 1 each in Algeria, Chad, Namibia and the United Kingdom.

4Mq4-79OTBIdZ2qaNNdA5w.zh: 馬利疫情更新,自今年11/21報告首例,截至12/9已確診5例病例,其中1例死亡。首例發生於該國西部庫利科羅地區,鄰近幾內亞邊境,病患於今年第47週死亡。該區跨境人口流動頻繁,當局已加強監測,並呼籲所有接觸者皆應隔離及注意個人衛生。
4Mq4-79OTBIdZ2qaNNdA5w.en: Update on Mali: since the first case was reported on 21 November this year, 5 confirmed cases had been recorded as of 9 December, of which 1 died. The first case occurred in Koulikoro region in the west of the country, near the Guinea border, and the patient died in week 47 of this year. Cross-border population movement in the area is frequent, so authorities have strengthened surveillance and call for all contacts to be quarantined and for attention to personal hygiene.

K9ssijP-lRta8C7CLnSU4g.zh: 本月更新:  全球自2022年5月截至今年11/28累計142國/地區報告17萬2千餘例確診病例,其中至少467例死亡(CFR:0.27%)。 今年截至第48週累計99國/地區報告5萬1千餘例確診病例,其中非洲區4萬3千餘例、美洲區4,442例、歐洲區2,429例、西太平洋區1,479例、東南亞區154例及東地中海區46例。非洲、歐洲、西太平洋及中東區疫情下降;惟美洲及東南亞區病例數上升。  其他更新: 馬利西部庫利科羅11/24報告首例死亡病例,其餘資訊不明,當局已加強邊境監測並隔離疑病例。 評估與建議: WHO於9/5終止「國際關注之公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC)」,但因非洲不同基因型持續流行且監測及診斷能力不足,資金及社區資源不足,仍將全球傳播風險評估為中等。此次由於無症狀感染者和疫區旅遊者病例未即時發現,導致Ib型傳播風險持續,非洲外的義大利、荷蘭、葡萄牙、西班牙和美國已被列為Ib型社區傳播區。評估對一般民眾傳播風險為低,但對MSM群體為中,尤其未固定性伴侶族群,建議各國提高檢驗能力,並完整疫調追蹤,呼籲高風險者接種疫苗。
K9ssijP-lRta8C7CLnSU4g.en: Monthly update: Since May 2022 and as of 28 November this year, 142 countries and areas have reported more than 172,000 confirmed cases globally, of which at least 467 died (CFR 0.27%). Year to date as of week 48, 99 countries and areas have reported more than 51,000 confirmed cases: more than 43,000 in the African Region, 4,442 in the Region of the Americas, 2,429 in the European Region, 1,479 in the Western Pacific Region, 154 in the South-East Asia Region and 46 in the Eastern Mediterranean Region. Cases have declined in the African, European, Western Pacific and Eastern Mediterranean regions, but risen in the Americas and South-East Asia. Other updates: In Koulikoro, western Mali, the first death was reported on 24 November; other information is unknown. Authorities have strengthened border surveillance and isolated suspected cases. Assessment and recommendations: WHO ended the Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on 5 September. However, because different genotypes continue to circulate in Africa, surveillance and diagnostic capacity are insufficient, and funding and community resources are inadequate, WHO still assesses the global transmission risk as moderate. Because cases among asymptomatic infected people and travelers from affected areas were not detected promptly, clade Ib transmission risk persists. Italy, the Netherlands, Portugal, Spain and the United States, outside Africa, have been listed as areas of clade Ib community transmission. The assessed risk to the general public is low, but moderate for men who have sex with men (MSM), especially those without a stable sexual partner. Countries are advised to improve testing capacity and complete contact tracing, and high-risk individuals are urged to get vaccinated.

bInLbkRMVDE04eWMXcEvBA.zh: WHO非洲區共計8國(阿爾及利亞、查德、幾內亞、馬利、茅利塔亞、日、奈及利亞、南非)累計報告逾2萬例疑病例,其中9,864 例經實驗室確診,1,252例死亡,多數病患為兒童及青少年族群。受限於診斷試劑/檢驗/臨床照護能力不足及白喉抗毒素(DAT)供應短缺等因素,嚴重影響疫情防治工作。WHO考量非洲區疫情可能持續擴散,評估非洲區整體公共衛生風險為高,另非洲區以外多數國家具備完善之免疫計畫與健全之監測系統,全球公共衛生風險為低。
bInLbkRMVDE04eWMXcEvBA.en: Eight countries in the WHO African Region (Algeria, Chad, Guinea, Mali, Mauritania, Niger, Nigeria and South Africa) have cumulatively reported more than 20,000 suspected cases, of which 9,864 were laboratory-confirmed and 1,252 died. Most patients are children and adolescents. Insufficient diagnostic reagents, testing and clinical care capacity, and shortages of diphtheria antitoxin (DAT) are seriously hindering outbreak prevention and control. WHO considers that the outbreak in the African Region may continue to spread, and assesses the overall public health risk in the African Region as high. Most countries outside the African Region have well-established immunization programmes and sound surveillance systems, so the global public health risk is low.

SmQNnsjwwRSYaK6TShBeng.zh: 非洲多國爆發疫情,  蘇丹首都喀土穆報告15例,且3例病例於3日內死亡,當地公衛狀況及防疫體系急遽惡化,專家示警當地將發生疫情,需相關部門立即介入。 阿爾及利亞東北部斯基克達省爆發群聚疫情,10/17-19間報告5例,其中2例死亡,包括1名25歲外國人及1名未接種疫苗之12歲當地女孩。病患皆於住院後因呼吸道併發症死亡,其餘3例仍在治療,當局已進行接觸者追蹤及暴露後預防工作,鄰近地區亦加強監測措施。 馬利報告343例疑病例,其中7例確診及25例死亡(CFR : 7.3%),病例多集中於該國中部莫普提(Mopti)地區,當局現進行疫苗接種活動,目前疫情已獲控制。
SmQNnsjwwRSYaK6TShBeng.en: Outbreaks have occurred in several African countries. Khartoum, the capital of Sudan, reported 15 cases, and three of the cases died within three days. Local public health conditions and the disease control system have deteriorated sharply, and experts warn that an outbreak will occur locally, calling for immediate intervention by the relevant authorities. In Skikda province in north-eastern Algeria, a cluster outbreak was reported: five cases were reported between 17 and 19 October, of which two died, including a 25-year-old foreigner and an unvaccinated 12-year-old local girl. The two deceased patients died of respiratory complications after hospitalization, and the other three cases are still under treatment. Authorities have carried out contact tracing and post-exposure prevention, and surveillance has been strengthened in neighbouring areas. Mali reported 343 suspected cases, of which 7 were confirmed and 25 died (CFR 7.3%). Cases are concentrated in the Mopti region of central Mali. Authorities are carrying out vaccination activities, and the outbreak is now reported to be under control.

tjA_q2iHEzNpZ9ArJes9Ow.zh: 茅利塔亞南部地區今年報告74例疑病例,其中7例死亡(CFR:9.5%),病例較去年同期下降33%,病患主要為15歲以下族群,顯示兒童常規疫苗接種出現免疫缺口,當地已組織應變小組並持續進行流行病學監測,由於該國南部邊境鄰近馬利/塞內加爾,跨境人口流動頻繁,且醫療資源匱乏,使當地易發生跨國傳播。
tjA_q2iHEzNpZ9ArJes9Ow.en: In southern Mauritania, 74 suspected cases were reported this year, of which 7 died (CFR 9.5%). Cases are 33% lower than in the same period last year, and most patients are under 15 years old, indicating immunization gaps in routine childhood vaccination. A local response team has been organized and epidemiological surveillance continues. Because the southern border is close to Mali and Senegal, cross-border population movement is frequent and medical resources are scarce, the area is prone to cross-border transmission.

INK9QIjivlSTTc5aJxESkg.zh: 本月更新:  全球自2022年6月截至今年7/25累計139國/地區報告15萬4千餘例確診病例,其中至少385例死亡(CFR:0.2%)。 全球今年截至第30週累計79國/地區報告3萬3,370例確診病例,其中非洲區2萬8,481例、美洲區2,343例、歐洲區1,706例、西太平洋區755例、東南亞區52例及東地中海區33例。  其他更新:  中國今年截至7/31報告23例Ib型確診病例,其中7例具疫區旅遊史,包含烏干達(2例)、坦尚亞(2例)、剛果民主共和國(2例)、西非國家(剛果、馬利),另2例具泊爾及1例具阿拉伯聯合大公國旅遊史,其餘個案為本土傳播,其中,包含居住在中國之非洲僑民。WHO基於所有通報群聚事件中,指標個案均能與旅遊史有流行病學關聯,故將該國傳播分類由「未知傳播鏈」更正為「與旅遊相關個案」,惟仍無法排除尚未偵測到之社區傳播可能性。當局已在疫區進行廢水監測,並加強衛教及提供無症狀者藥物。 澳大利亞7/19報告新增2例Ib型病例,案1近期有烏干達旅遊史,案2為案1家庭接觸者,當局已加強監測疫情。 英國7/22新增1例Ib型病例,為成年男性,具肯亞旅遊史,當局已展開疫調與監測,並提供接觸者疫苗。  評估與建議: WHO於2025年6月5日召開國際衛生條例(IHR)緊急委員會第四次會議,討論2024年M痘疫情上升的情形。會議確認該事件仍構成國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC),並針對受影響國家提出各項臨時建議,包括加強監測、提升診斷能力、推動疫苗接種、改善臨床護理、強化跨境合作,以及加強社區參與和資金支持,並將現行建議延長至2025年8月20日。
INK9QIjivlSTTc5aJxESkg.en: Monthly update: since June 2022 and as of 25 July this year, 139 countries and territories have cumulatively reported more than 154,000 confirmed cases, of which at least 385 died (CFR: 0.2%). This year, as of week 30, 79 countries and territories have cumulatively reported 33,370 confirmed cases: African Region 28,481; Region of the Americas 2,343; European Region 1,706; Western Pacific Region 755; South-East Asia Region 52; and Eastern Mediterranean Region 33. Other updates: China reported 23 confirmed clade Ib cases as of 31 July this year, of which seven had travel history to affected areas, including Uganda (2), Tanzania (2), the DRC (2), and West African countries (Congo, Mali); two had travel history to Nepal and one to the UAE. The other cases were locally transmitted, including African nationals living in China. Based on all reported clusters in which the index cases had epidemiological links to travel, WHO has reclassified China's transmission category from 'unknown transmission chain' to 'travel-associated cases', although undetected community transmission cannot be ruled out. Authorities have launched wastewater surveillance in affected areas, strengthened health education, and provided medicines to asymptomatic people. Australia reported two new clade Ib cases on 19 July: case 1 had recent travel history to Uganda, and case 2 was a household contact of case 1; authorities have strengthened surveillance. The UK reported one new clade Ib case on 22 July, an adult male with travel history to Kenya; authorities have launched epidemiological investigation and surveillance and provided vaccines to contacts. Assessment and recommendations: WHO held the fourth meeting of the IHR Emergency Committee on 5 June 2025 to discuss the rise in mpox since 2024. The meeting confirmed that the event still constitutes a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), and issued temporary recommendations for affected countries, including strengthening surveillance, improving diagnostic capacity, promoting vaccination, improving clinical care, strengthening cross-border cooperation, and enhancing community engagement and financial support. Current recommendations were extended to 20 August 2025.

vPaxu9csjrYdIOHN8dblag.zh: 宏都拉斯疫情上升,今年截至第24週累計報告約7,500例病例,為中美洲病例數第二多之國家,病例集中於中區、聖佩德羅蘇拉等區,另美洲地區今年病例數較去年同期下降70%。 馬利疫情上升,今年迄今累計1,918例病例(380例確診),為非洲病例數第二多之國家,分布於全國11個地區,近1週報告52例病例(11例確診),以西南部巴馬科及卡伊病例數為多,非洲今年迄今共7國報告近8,000例病例及7例死亡,近期主要流行型別為DENV-2。
vPaxu9csjrYdIOHN8dblag.en: Dengue is rising in Honduras. As of week 24 this year, about 7,500 cumulative cases have been reported, the second highest in Central America. Cases are concentrated in the Central district and in San Pedro Sula. Case numbers in the Americas this year are 70% lower than in the same period last year. Dengue is also rising in Mali. So far this year, 1,918 cumulative cases (380 confirmed) have been reported, the second highest in Africa, distributed across 11 regions nationwide. In the most recent week, 52 cases (11 confirmed) were reported, with the most in Bamako and Kayes in the southwest. Across Africa, 7 countries have reported nearly 8,000 cases and 7 deaths this year, and the main recently circulating serotype is DENV-2.

xEwUk8l5_SOnMIeF9R0L9w.zh: 非洲疫情更新,今年截至10/17累計4國報告7,086例病例,其中1,469例確診,492例死亡(CFR:6.94%);流行國家中,以奈及利亞報告3,302例最為嚴峻,另有日報告2,781例、馬利707例及中非共和國296例。
xEwUk8l5_SOnMIeF9R0L9w.en: Africa epidemic update: As of 17 October this year, four countries had reported 7,086 cases cumulatively, including 1,469 confirmed and 492 deaths (CFR 6.94%). Among the affected countries, Nigeria reported the most, with 3,302 cases; Niger reported 2,781, Mali 707 and the Central African Republic 296.
